# Executive summary

State the overall outcome in two or three sentences. Name the
strengths and the main shortfall.

# Observations

One observation, discussion, and recommendation (ODR) entry per
issue. Record what happened, why it happened, and what should change.

## Observation 1

**Observation.** What actually happened.

**Discussion.** Why it happened, and what the impact was.

**Recommendation.** The change that prevents recurrence.

# Action items

Record each action with an owner and a due date.

| Action | Owner | Due |

# Conclusion

Close with the overall judgement and the priority of the actions.
